profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at 7-Eleven
profile.summary: I always try to maintain a positive future oriented outlook. I enjoy hearing, discussing and promoting great ideas from friends and colleagues and the process of bouncing ideas around with in a group. I try to always remember to look for who is ultimately being helped by anything I am doing in work or life.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior System Administrator for 11,000+ Enterprise Chrome OS Systems, 
System Engineer Responsible for System Images and Setup and recovery automation on US and Canadian Retail POS running Windows 10/11 IOT

positions.title: Software Development Contractor
positions.description: Modifying existing Dynamic MVC retail application in C# with a Oracle 11g DB. implemented integrations to partner services and new real-time services in an existing ESL. utilized Web API 1.0 to implement an API layer due to system limitations and developed stored procedures and custom types for plsql functionality.

positions.description:
Atlanta, GA project -

assembled, calibrated and debugged the control software for a robotic arm prototype.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Worked on Location in Richmond VA as a contractor for World View Solutions a Geo-spatial Information Services company. I worked on additions to one of their GIS projects in C# ASP.net MVC.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop internal corporate intranet services for managing customer accounts and business relationships. 
Project Lead on Accounting and General Ledger Reconciliation project.
Manage Team Foundation Services
Build Administrator
Established Versioning procedures
Implemented a Production/Staging/Development project branch.

positions.title: .Net/API developer
positions.description: Contract to hire position at FinFit .LLC developing their internal corporate intranet services, Accounting/GL system and API development/testing for interfacing with partner companies.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: I modify and maintain the content behind various states supported by the desktop software used in Liberty Tax Service franchise offices. Each year as the tax laws change I update the logic and math behind forms and tax calculations to be consistent with the tax laws of each state I am responsible for at the time. I have worked on the tax logic and conversion to Modern Electronic Efile in XML format on the following states AR, CT, DC, DE, HI, IL, MN, MO, OK, OR, SC, WI, WV. We are developing using an agile framework and parallel deployment of our next generation dual mode web based diy and professional product utilizing C# and JSON for use by our franchise offices and online taxpayers while continuing to support and update the sun setting software currently in use by our offices. We utilize LUA scripts, and python scripts during development and testing. During my time I developed the Modernized Electronic filing baseline project which reduced overall support issues related to transmission by over 70% and resulted in developers having an about an extra hour a day to work on other development work during specific times of the year.

positions.title: Tier I Advanced Technial support
positions.description: Provide support for customers on linux webservers. Troubleshoot sql, dns, domain,  email and tcp/ip network security issues through chat email and phone. Utilizing both cpanel and WHM on the front end and Linux terminal ssh connections on the backend.

positions.title: Technical Support Representative
positions.description: Tasked with resolving both Canadian and US issues with their office systems running Windows XP and Vista with occasional Server 2003 computers in a small office network setup using WebEx for remote support of US and Canadian Offices. Encouraged to develop automated batch and VB.net files to facilitate in resolution of issues.

positions.title: Esmart Intern
positions.description: I am currently doing scope and requirements verification, as well as testing the online esmart web software, and PDF Form building for Tax form outputs to be printed to.

positions.title: Technical Support Representative
positions.description: Responsible for handling technical troubleshooting within an enterprise environment, including malware/virus removal and damage mitigation, system crashes, slow-downs and data recoveries. Engaged and tracked issues, with responsibility for the timely documentation, escalation (when appropriate), resolution and closure of trouble tickets.
